nodes.description: Owner address of the contract, set from msg.sender at construction and used by access-control modifiers.
Address nominated as next owner, finalized by claimContractOwnership.
Current asset implementation address used for delegate-style forwarding of asset calls.
Proposed next asset implementation address during upgrade process.
Timestamp when the upgrade proposal was made; used for the freeze-time check.
Platform contract that stores balances, allowances and ownership of the asset.
Immutable asset symbol used as key into the platform.
Mapping(bytes4 => mapping(address => bool)) of allowed oracle callers per method signature.
Address allowed to change allowances on behalf of holders.
Asset contract address allowed to move holder day/month limits.
Service controller used to resolve pending manager and proxy addresses.
Total number of registered holders; iterated and incremented with SafeMath.
Mapping(address => uint) of spending allowances manipulated by changeAllowance.
Pending manager contract used by MultiSigAdapter for multi-signature confirmations.
Mapping of contracts authorized to add pending transactions.
Mapping(bytes32 => Guard) with vote counters and state for each pending transaction.
GroupsAccessManager address used to verify group membership during voting.
Caller address, used for ownership checks, oracle checks, group membership and vote attribution.
Block timestamp (now) used as the upgrade freeze-time start and in the freeze-time comparison.
Owner-only function that destroys the contract and sends funds to the caller.
Owner-only two-step ownership transfer proposal.
Pending owner finalizes ownership transfer.
One-time initializer setting platform, symbol and name; callable by anyone before initialization.
ERC20 transfer entry point forwarding to the asset implementation.
ERC20 transferFrom entry point forwarding to the asset implementation.
ERC20 approve entry point forwarding to the asset implementation.
Asset-owner-only proposal of a new implementation; records timestamp when not initial setup.
Finalizes the upgrade after the freeze time has elapsed; timestamp dependent.
Asset-owner-only cancellation of a pending upgrade.
Implementation-only hook that performs the transfer on the platform.
Implementation-only hook that performs an allowance transfer on the platform.
Implementation-only hook that sets allowance on the platform.
Emits the ERC20 Transfer event; callable only by the platform.
Payable fallback that forwards msg.data and msg.value to the current asset implementation.
Returns the current asset implementation address.
Owner-only registration of oracle addresses per method signature.
Owner-only removal of registered oracles.
Owner-only registration of voting policy rules keyed by (sig, contract, group).
Records an accepting vote for a pending transaction and may confirm it.
Records a declining vote for a pending transaction and may cancel it.
Revokes the caller's own vote on a pending transaction.
Internal vote removal updating accepted/declined counters.
Withdrawal-role-only update of a holder allowance after balance check.
Asset-only reduction of a holder's day and month send limits.
Asset-only increase of a holder's day and month send limits.
Owner-only update of the withdrawal role address.
Oracle/owner-only registration of a new holder and its first address.
Oracle/owner-only addition of an alternative address to an existing holder.
Oracle/owner-only removal of an alternative holder address.
Internal resolver returning the asset implementation as ATxAssetInterface.
Internal helper that forwards a transfer to the asset implementation.
suicide(msg.sender) executed inside destroy, sending the full balance to the caller.
Arbitrary external value call forwarding msg.data to the resolved implementation from the fallback.
External call into the platform for a referenced transfer.
External call into the asset implementation for an allowance transfer.
External call into the asset implementation to set an allowance.
External call registering a multi-signature transaction into the pending manager.
pendingVersionTimestamp.add(UPGRADE_FREEZE_TIME) arithmetic used in the freeze-time comparison.
SafeMath subtraction of limits/vote counters (potential underflow if invariants break).
SafeMath addition of limits/counters (potential overflow).
Target address parameter of changeContractOwnership.
New implementation address parameter of proposeUpgrade.
Array of method signatures in addOracles/removeOracles.
Array of oracle addresses in addOracles/removeOracles.
Transaction key parameter of accept/decline/revoke.
Voting group name parameter of accept/decline.
Amount parameter of withdrawFrom/transfer.

Original caller parameter of the onlyAccess-guarded implementation hooks.

edges.reason: onlyContractOwner requires msg.sender == contractOwner before destroy executes.
destroy executes suicide(msg.sender).
selfdestruct transfers the whole balance to msg.sender.
onlyContractOwner gates changeContractOwnership.
Parameter _to is used in changeContractOwnership.
changeContractOwnership writes pendingContractOwner = _to.
claimContractOwnership requires pendingContractOwner == msg.sender.
claimContractOwnership reads pendingContractOwner.
claimContractOwnership promotes the pending owner into contractOwner.
init has no access control and can be front-run before platform is set.
init assigns platform address.
init assigns the symbol-derived smbl.
transfer delegates to _transferWithReference.
_value parameter is used in transfer.
_to parameter is used in transfer.
_transferWithReference calls the asset implementation __transferWithReference.
_getAsset reads latestVersion.
_transferWithReference resolves the implementation through _getAsset.
_getAsset invokes getLatestVersion.
getLatestVersion returns latestVersion.
__transferWithReference performs an external platform call that can re-enter.
onlyAccess(_sender) compares the stored implementation with msg.sender.
onlyAccess uses getLatestVersion() to authorize the hook.
platform.proxyTransferWithReference is invoked on the platform contract.
transferFrom forwards the call to an external asset implementation.
msg.sender is passed as _sender into the external transferFrom call.
__transferFromWithReference delegates to the platform.
approve forwards the call to an external asset implementation.
__approve delegates to platform.proxyApprove.
msg.sender is passed as _sender into the external approve call.
fallback resolves the implementation before forwarding the call.
fallback forwards msg.data and msg.value to the implementation contract.
msg.sender is forwarded as _sender in the fallback external call.
Any caller can trigger the fallback and therefore the arbitrary external call.
proposeUpgrade sets pendingVersion, affecting upgrade control flow.
_newVersion parameter is used in proposeUpgrade.
proposeUpgrade stores now as pendingVersionTimestamp.
block.timestamp (now) is used as the freeze-time start.
pendingVersionTimestamp.add(UPGRADE_FREEZE_TIME) arithmetic.
commitUpgrade performs the freeze-time addition.
commitUpgrade compares the computed value against now.
commitUpgrade reads pendingVersion.
commitUpgrade sets latestVersion, changing the implementation address.
onlyAssetOwner validates msg.sender via platform.isOwner.
proposeUpgrade queries platform.isOwner for authorization.
platform.isOwner uses the smbl symbol in the ownership check.
purgeUpgrade deletes pendingVersion with onlyAssetOwner protection.
emitTransfer is gated by onlyPlatform (msg.sender == address(platform)).
addOracles writes privileged entries into the oracles mapping.
onlyContractOwner gates addOracles.
_signatures parameter is used in addOracles.
_oracles parameter is used in addOracles.
removeOracles deletes privileged entries from the oracles mapping.
onlyContractOwner gates removeOracles.
registerHolder is gated by onlyOracleOrOwner reading oracles[msg.sig][msg.sender].
onlyOracleOrOwner checks msg.sender against oracles mapping or owner.
registerHolder increments holdersCount.
addHolderAddress is gated by onlyOracleOrOwner using the oracles mapping.
addHolderAddress checks msg.sender through onlyOracleOrOwner.
removeHolderAddress is gated by onlyOracleOrOwner using the oracles mapping.
removeHolderAddress checks msg.sender through onlyOracleOrOwner.
addPolicyRule queries accessManager (GroupsAccessManager) for group existence.
onlyContractOwner gates addPolicyRule.
accept requires the caller to be a member of the voting group.
accept calls GroupsAccessManager(accessManager).isUserInGroup for msg.sender.
accept reads the guard state before recording the vote.
accept writes the caller vote and accepted counters into txKey2guard.
_key parameter identifies the guard entry in accept.
_votingGroupName parameter selects the counted group in accept.
_groupAcceptedVotesCount is incremented with +1 when recording an accept vote.
decline checks group membership of msg.sender before counting the vote.
decline reads and writes the guard state in txKey2guard.
revoke revokes the vote belonging to msg.sender.
revoke delegates the vote removal to _revoke.
_revoke mutates the guard vote counters in txKey2guard.
_revoke uses SafeMath sub on accepted/declined counters.
_revoke identifies the vote through the _user address (msg.sender from revoke).
changeAllowance is gated by onlyWithdrawal checking msg.sender.
withdrawal state variable is compared against msg.sender.
changeAllowance writes the allowance mapping.
withdrawFrom is gated by onlyAsset checking msg.sender.
assetAddress is compared against msg.sender in onlyAsset.
_value is subtracted from the holder day and month limits.
withdrawFrom uses SafeMath sub on sendLimPerDay and sendLimPerMonth.
_holderAddress parameter is used in withdrawFrom.
depositTo uses SafeMath add on the holder limits.
setWithdraw is gated by onlyContractOwner.
setWithdraw rewrites the privileged withdrawal address.
The pendingManager address is used to call PendingManager.addTx during multisig.
addTx on the pending manager is gated by onlyAuthorized using authorized[msg.sender].
addTx registers the calling contract into the authorized mapping.
The computed _txHash is passed as _key into PendingManager.addTx.

normalization_plan.reason: The ownership target parameter is only meaningful inside changeContractOwnership and can be folded into that function node.
The proposed implementation address is used only by proposeUpgrade and should be collapsed into it.
The signature array is consumed only by the oracle-registration function.
The oracle address array is consumed only by the oracle-registration function.
The transaction key parameter is scoped to the voting functions and normalizes into the vote action node.
The voting group parameter is scoped to the vote action and normalizes into it.
The amount parameter drives the SafeMath subtraction inside withdrawFrom and folds into it.
The holder address parameter is only used to resolve the holder record in withdrawFrom.
The original caller parameter exists purely for the onlyAccess authorization check in the hook.
The local accepted-vote counter is an arithmetic artifact of accept and merges into that function.
The computed transaction hash is produced solely to be submitted to the PendingManager.addTx external call.
